method: One frozen baseline installation with startup-only replacement of the tested 128-channel reader or its digest/buffer optimization. Cold disk arms evict private metadata pages with fadvise and verify residency using mincore. Eager includes production hydration before local restore; empty starts without a publication. Production hydrate reconstructs authenticated remote files for the local seed. Fresh JVM/clean graph and private cache per run; fixed source/tool/environment identity; fresh tiny genrule forces publication. Three samples per arm in rotated order. Remote timed commands connect directly to the worker; the created proxy is bypassed and records no RPCs. Local warmup excluded.

publication_probe.purpose: One new key forces equivalent publication work; six original binaries remain checked.
